cases.name: testInterfaceDefinition
cases.src:
*"* components of interface IF_ANY_INTERFACE "!

Any Description

interface if_pretty_print_case_and_indent "#EC NUMBER_METHODS public. interfaces IF_ANY_INTERFACE. interfaces IF_OTHER_INTERFACE. "!

Data Description

data MS_DATA type TY_S_DATA read-only. "!

Constant Description

constants CO_INDICATOR type CHAR1 value 'C' ##NO_TEXT. methods ANY_METHOD importing !ITS_TABLE type IF_ANY_INTERFACE=>TY_TS_TABLE_TYPE. methods OTHER_METHOD returning value(RV_FLAG) type ABAP_BOOL. endinterface.
cases.exp:
*"* components of interface IF_ANY_INTERFACE "!

Any Description

INTERFACE if_pretty_print_case_and_indent "#EC NUMBER_METHODS PUBLIC. INTERFACES if_any_interface. INTERFACES if_other_interface. "!

Data Description

DATA ms_data TYPE ty_s_data READ-ONLY. "!

Constant Description

CONSTANTS co_indicator TYPE char1 VALUE 'C' ##NO_TEXT. METHODS any_method IMPORTING !its_table TYPE if_any_interface=>ty_ts_table_type. METHODS other_method RETURNING VALUE(rv_flag) TYPE abap_bool. ENDINTERFACE.

cases.name: testDataDeclarationFromUpper
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    DATA:
      LOOP TYPE TYPE LENGTH 10,
      FOR TYPE LINE OF TYPE,
      DO TYPE REF TO TYPE,
      ENDFOR TYPE TABLE OF TYPE WITH DEFAULT KEY,
      ENDDO TYPE SORTED TABLE OF REF TO TYPE WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY,
      WHILE TYPE RANGE OF TYPE INITIAL SIZE 4,
      ENDWHILE LIKE TYPE,
      ENDLOOP LIKE LINE OF TYPE,
      IF LIKE REF TO TYPE,
      ENDIF LIKE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO TYPE WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    DATA:
      loop TYPE type LENGTH 10,
      for TYPE LINE OF type,
      do TYPE REF TO type,
      endfor TYPE TABLE OF type WITH DEFAULT KEY,
      enddo TYPE SORTED TABLE OF REF TO type WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY,
      while TYPE RANGE OF type INITIAL SIZE 4,
      endwhile LIKE type,
      endloop LIKE LINE OF type,
      if LIKE REF TO type,
      endif LIKE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO type WITH UNIQUE DEFAULT KEY.
  ENDMETHOD.
